description: The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism publishes a national welfare-facility inventory in its National Land Numerical Information series. The reviewed version documents 2011 and 2015 coverage and identifies facility locations and thematic attributes for GIS use. Prefectural files are offered as GML and Shapefile. This is a historical inventory; locations, names and operating status must be checked before use in a current infrastructure model. Published by Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (Japan). Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. The provider lists GML, Shapefile access formats. Reuse licence: Provider-specific National Land Numerical Information terms; the reviewed page marks this version non-commercial. The described release is free to access; licence restrictions still apply. Potential simulation uses include capacity planning, hazard exposure. Related catalogue records: platform-qgis. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
